name: Payment due reminder
subject_template: FNU Portal — Payment due for invoice {invoice_id}
body_template:
Hi {full_name},

This is a friendly reminder that invoice {invoice_id} for FJ${amount_fjd} is due on {due_date}.

You can pay online at {portal_url}/pay or use the payment plan at {portal_url}/account.

If you've already paid, please disregard this message.

— FNU Student Services

name: Payment overdue
body_template:
Hi {full_name},

Invoice {invoice_id} for FJ${amount_fjd} was due on {due_date} and is now overdue.

Please settle this balance at {portal_url}/pay to avoid further action.

— FNU Student Services

name: De-registration warning
subject_template: FNU Portal — De-registration warning for invoice {invoice_id}
body_template:
Hi {full_name},

Invoice {invoice_id} remains unpaid and we are now {weeks_overdue} weeks past the due date. If payment is not received within the next 7 days, your course registration will be cancelled.

Contact Finance or pay online at {portal_url}/pay.

— FNU Student Services

name: Payment confirmed
body_template:
Hi {full_name},

We've received your payment of FJ${amount_fjd} for invoice {invoice_id}. Reference: {reference}.

You can view your payment history at {portal_url}/account.

— FNU Student Services

name: Course registration confirmation
body_template:
Hi {full_name},

Your course registration for {semester} is confirmed. Invoice {invoice_id} (FJ${amount_fjd}) has been generated.

View your timetable at {portal_url}/timetable and your courses at {portal_url}/courses.

— FNU Student Services

name: Application submitted
body_template:
Hi {full_name},

Thank you for applying to FNU. We've received your application ({application_number}) and it is now under review.

You'll hear from us within 10 business days. Questions? Reply to this email.

— FNU Admissions

name: Application status updated
subject_template: FNU — Your application status has changed
body_template:
Hi {full_name},

Your application {application_number} status is now: {status}.

{status_note}

View details at {portal_url}/applications/{application_number}.

— FNU Admissions

name: Offer issued
body_template:
Hi {full_name},

Congratulations! Your offer for {programme_name} is ready. Accept or decline via the link below:

{portal_url}/offer/{token}

This link expires in 7 days.

— FNU Admissions

name: Deadline reminder
body_template:
Hi {full_name},

Reminder: {deadline_name} closes on {deadline_date}.

{details}

— FNU Student Services

name: Offer issued (SMS)
body_template: FNU: Your offer is ready. Accept: {portal_url}/offer/{token} (expires in 7 days)
